project_summary: Analysis of the initial test requirement text to establish baseline functionality verification and system integration checks.
identified_risks: Insufficient requirement details provided in raw text to determine full functional scope.
Risk of misaligned acceptance criteria due to ambiguous user expectations.

user_stories.title: Validate Baseline System Requirement
user_stories.user_story: As a Quality Assurance Engineer, I want to execute automated baseline tests against the system requirements, so that I can verify application stability and core functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given the test suite is configured, When the validation pipeline is executed for the test requirement, Then all core health checks should pass without errors.
Given an invalid test configuration, When the validation suite runs, Then clear failure logs should be generated for troubleshooting.
